## Claims
- [source-backed] Bigrassmannians \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) satisfy \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\) and \(t>r+s-n\); their parameters are \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 187-235]
- [source-backed] A valid tuple requires \(n,r,i,j,a,b,N\ge1\), \(r<n\), \(a+j\le r\), \(a+i\le n-r\), \(b\le i,j\), and \(N\le ab\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 300-304]
- [proved] Put \(q=n-r\) and
  \[
  (r^\vee,s^\vee,t^\vee)=(q,n-s,q-s+t).
  \]
  Then \(1\le t^\vee\le r^\vee,s^\vee\le n\) and
  \[
  t^\vee>r^\vee+s^\vee-n.
  \]
  Indeed, \(t^\vee=q-s+t\ge1\) follows from \(t>r+s-n\); \(t^\vee\le q=r^\vee\) follows from \(t\le s\); \(t^\vee\le n-s=s^\vee\) follows from \(t\le r\); and
  \[
  t^\vee-(r^\vee+s^\vee-n)=t>0.
  \]
  The original inequalities also force \(r,s<n\), hence \(r^\vee,s^\vee\ge1\).
- [proved] The conjugated parameters are
  \[
  i^\vee=s^\vee-t^\vee+1=j,\qquad
  j^\vee=r^\vee-t^\vee+1=i,
  \]
  and consequently
  \[
  a^\vee=\min(n-r^\vee-i^\vee,r^\vee-j^\vee)
         =\min(r-j,q-i)=a,\qquad b^\vee=b.
  \]
- [proved] The original core and both family upper shapes lie in the \(q^r\) box:
  \[
  i\le q,\quad j\le r,\quad i+a\le q,\quad j+a\le r,\quad b\le i,j.
  \]
  Here \(q-i=t^\vee-1\ge0\), \(r-j=t-1\ge0\), and the two inequalities involving \(a\) follow from \(a=\min(q-i,r-j)\). The transformed statements are exactly
  \[
  j\le r,\quad i\le q,\quad j+a\le r,\quad i+a\le q,\quad b\le j,i,
  \]
  so the transformed lower family is contained in the \(r^q\) box.
- [proved] Conjugation of partitions gives the exact family correspondence
  \[
  \left\{\lambda:j^i\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(j^i,b^a)\right\}'
  =
  \left\{\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\right\}.
  \]
  This uses \(b\le i,j\); the transpose of the \(a\times b\) lower adjoinment is an \(a\)-wide right adjoinment in the first \(b\) rows.
- [proved] If \(a\ge1\) and \(1\le N\le ab\), then both
  \[
  (n,r,i,j,a,b,N),\qquad(n,r^\vee,j,i,a,b,N)
  \]
  are valid: positivity is clear, \(r^\vee=q<n\), and the transformed containment conditions are
  \[
  a+i\le q=r^\vee,\qquad a+j\le r=n-r^\vee.
  \]
- [proved] The \(a=0\) boundary is excluded from valid tuples, since validity requires \(a\ge1\). Moreover,
  \[
  a=0\iff (q-i=0)\ \text{or}\ (r-j=0)
       \iff (i=q)\ \text{or}\ (j=r).
  \]
  Under parameter conjugation these alternatives interchange. In either case both \(b^a\) adjoinments are empty, so each relevant family is the singleton core; no condition \(1\le N\le ab=0\) can hold.

## Strategy
Directly verified the parameter involution \((r,s,t)\mapsto(n-r,n-s,n-r-s+t)\), its bigrassmannian inequalities, all box bounds, family transposition, and valid-tuple conditions. The requested standalone admissibility certificate is established. No minimality or parent theorem is inferred.
